protocol.rss_plateau_definition: median summed workerd RSS over the final two seconds of load in the phase
protocol.rss_recovery_definition: post-10s-idle RSS within the larger of 10% or 16 MiB of the phase baseline
protocol.rate_limit_note: Phase A/C share one fresh primary key (exactly 60 total requests, within the 60/min/key limit). Concurrency workers use distinct fresh keys so the sweep measures verification capacity rather than deliberate per-key throttling.
protocol.cpu_budget_note: Local CPU/wall/RSS are not the production Cloudflare isolate budget: this measures a workstation workerd process, not the production CPU/memory cap. Production numbers come from the deployed Task I measurement.
